subject: Knee osteoarthritis isn’t inevitable — here’s what you can do
script: From Agewell Brief: Knee osteoarthritis isn’t inevitable — here’s what you can do. Cartilage breakdown doesn’t have to dictate your mobility. Targeted muscle strength, weight control, and anti-inflammatory eating can reduce joint stress and slow progression. Knee osteoarthritis is not a passive sentence. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
